basics.label: AI/ML Engineer
basics.summary: Computer science graduate building machine-learning models and the Python services around them. Comfortable from data cleaning and model evaluation to a documented FastAPI endpoint. Looking for a first role where the work is judged by what ships.

projects.name: Diabetes Risk Dashboard
projects.description: Gradio app serving a scikit-learn pipeline, deployed on Hugging Face Spaces with its own test metrics.
highlights: 0.7597 accuracy and 0.8311 ROC-AUC on a stratified 20% hold-out
0.8446 cross-validated ROC-AUC with imputation inside the pipeline
Model artifact stores its own metrics; the UI cannot display a number the file does not contain

projects.name: Developer Skill Tracker API
projects.description: Layered FastAPI service for skills and learning journals with referential integrity and generated documentation.
highlights: 12 routes across two resources with Pydantic v2 validation
RESTRICT-style delete guard prevents orphaned journal entries

projects.name: CryptoMaster
projects.description: University team project: PHP/MySQL backend for a crypto dashboard with a virtual wallet.
highlights: 13 API actions over Binance public market data, capped at 120 USDT pairs
PDO prepared statements throughout; bcrypt cost 12; session ID regeneration
Owned the backend and database in a team of three
